privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At KULTURA we take your data privacy seriously. This policy explains what information we collect, what we use it for, and what rights you have over it.
privacy.s1Body: KULTURA is a personal project under active development. You can exercise any of the rights described in this policy through the suggestions form inside the app.
privacy.s2Body: Account data (email, username, avatar, optional bio, preferred language); your personal library (saved titles, ratings, progress); social activity (friendships, private messages, shared lists, groups and posts within them); and technical metadata needed to run the service (IP address, used only to rate-limit abuse of the API — never for profiling).
privacy.s3Title: 3. What we use your data for
privacy.s3Body: To provide the service (library, social features, recommendations), to generate personalized recommendations via artificial intelligence based on your library, and to keep the app secure and stable.
privacy.s4Body: We process your data to perform the contract you accept when you register, and in some cases based on explicit consent (e.g. when requesting an AI recommendation) or legitimate interest in keeping the platform secure.
privacy.s5Body: We use infrastructure providers (Supabase for database and authentication, Vercel for hosting, optionally Sentry for error diagnostics) and an AI provider (Anthropic Claude) to generate recommendations from your library. We query public third-party catalogs (TMDB, Jikan, RAWG, Open Library, ComicVine, MangaDex) to show information about movies, series, books, comics, manga and games — these are public content queries that do not send your personal data. None of these providers receive data for advertising purposes.
privacy.s6Title: 6. How long we keep your data
privacy.s6Body: For as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, your personal data and library are permanently erased (see the account settings section).
privacy.s7Body: You have the right to access, rectify, delete and export your data, and to object to its processing. You can delete your account and export your data directly from Settings; for any other request, use the suggestions form.
privacy.s8Body: We only use the cookies strictly necessary to keep you signed in (managed by Supabase Auth). We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies. We count visits with Vercel Web Analytics, which is anonymous, uses no cookies and identifies no one.
privacy.s9Body: The service is not directed at children under 16. If we become aware of an account belonging to a child under that age, we will delete it.
privacy.s10Body: We may update this policy as the service evolves. Material changes will be announced inside the app.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By creating an account on KULTURA you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.
terms.s1Body: Using KULTURA means you accept these terms and the privacy policy. If you do not agree, you must not use the service.
terms.s2Body: KULTURA is an app for discovering, tracking and sharing cultural content (movies, series, anime, books, comics, manga and games), with social features (friends, lists, groups, chat) and AI-generated recommendations.
terms.s3Body: You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for all activity under your account. You must provide accurate information when registering.
terms.s4Body: You may not use the service to harass other users, post illegal content, send spam, attempt to breach the platform's security, or automate access in a way that harms other users.
terms.s5Body: You retain ownership of what you post (messages, lists, comments). By posting it, you grant us the minimum license needed to store and display it within the service to whoever is entitled to see it per that feature's privacy settings.
terms.s6Body: Title information (synopses, cover art, ratings) comes from public third-party catalogs (TMDB, Jikan, RAWG, Open Library, ComicVine, MangaDex) and belongs to their respective owners. KULTURA claims no rights over that content.
terms.s7Body: AI-generated recommendations are automatic suggestions based on your library and may contain errors or inaccuracies. They do not replace your own judgment.
terms.s8Body: You can delete your account at any time from Settings. We may suspend or delete accounts that violate these terms.
terms.s9Body: The service is provided "as is", without guarantees of continuous availability. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the service.
terms.s10Body: These terms are governed by Spanish law, without prejudice to any rights consumer protection rules in your country of residence may grant you.
terms.s11Body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be announced inside the app.
